title: Synthetic-input integration oracle (agent buffer ↔ chainloaded XBE)
purpose: Validate that the oracle agent's persistent kernel-pool controller buffer survives an XLaunchXBE chainload byte-for-byte and is correctly read by the xbed_input_synth shim layer. Renders a deterministic pattern derived from the synthetic state set via Mac-side controller.set RPCs prior to chainload; the orchestrator compares the captured front buffer against expected.py:from_state(...) computed from the SAME state values.

any/any/any.notes: Default reference is the zero-state pattern (all opaque-black). For non-zero pre-set states, the runner should call expected.py:from_state(buttons=..., lt=..., ...) directly with the same values it passed to controller.set.

preconditions: controller.buffer-info reports a kernel-pool buffer at phys != 0
controller.set port=0 was called BEFORE this XBE was chainloaded
no concurrent controller.set during the chainload + render window
